digest.component_or_area: bug-trend prevention program; observability, gates, migrations, and skill discipline
propositions: A 344-bug corpus analysis identified recurring escape channels including surface-parity gaps, contention semantics, inert config, wall-clock flakes, unlocked store writes, auto-filer breakage, comment-based provenance rot, and unreviewed bug fixes.

Bug provenance must be observable at creation and trend-queryable without new required user input, and deterministic pre-LLM gates must exist for git bypasses, unread config fields, wall-clock asserts, incomplete ACs, comment rot, and oversized bug-fix diffs lacking plan-review attestation.

Production shell logic in reconcile-bridge, canary workflows, probe harness, and vote normalizer must be migrated to Python; the reconciler transport must be typed end-to-end with property-test-pinned field asymmetries and deduplicated pagination loops.

Canary and automation bug filing must follow a hardened dedup pattern with a documented bug-creation contract; engine-layer validation placement must be advisory-enforced at plan review; and code comments citing dead identifiers must be remediated to ticket citations with CI regression prevention.

The remediation of missing completion attestation for epic 96d1-6ccf-c73a-485d required grandfathering pre-330c children whose signed hash byte-exactly matches legacy non-normalized recomputation, allowing the completion verifier to re-pass and sign the completion-verifier attestation.

rebar-debug and rebar-implement skills and the shared test-design standard must encode discipline upgrades including ticket writebacks, two-axis invariant sweeps, surface census, config-effect contrast, case-(c) contention triggers, gate-finding oracle upgrades, and residual-gap disposition.
